questions.stem: A company has 30 AWS accounts in us-east-1. The central operations team works only in a monitoring account. The team must create alarms in that account on metrics from the other accounts, and must run one CloudWatch Logs Insights query across log groups in many accounts at once. Only selected namespaces and log groups may be shared. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

choices.text: Set up CloudWatch cross-account observability with the central account as the monitoring account, and share filtered namespaces and log groups from each source account.
Create a dashboard in each account, and have the operations team switch roles into each account to create alarms and run queries.
Run an AWS Lambda function in each account that copies metrics into the central account with PutMetricData, and copy the logs to a central log group.
Create a cross-account dashboard in the central account, and create the alarms in each source account.

explanation.summary: cross-account observability では、監視アカウントで、元のアカウントのメトリクスのグラフを作り、元のアカウントのメトリクスを見るアラームを作り、1 つの Logs Insights の問い合わせで複数のアカウントの複数のロググループを調べられる。元のアカウントは、共有するメトリクスの名前空間やロググループを絞れる。

per_choice.A: 正しい。監視アカウントでアラームも問い合わせもでき、共有する物を絞れる。
per_choice.B: アカウントごとの作業になり、1 つの問い合わせで複数のアカウントを調べる要件にも合わない。
per_choice.C: 自分で写す仕組みを作ることになり、手間が大きい。
per_choice.D: アラームを中央のアカウントで作る要件に合わない。

references.quote: Create alarms in the monitoring account that watch metrics in source accounts.
A single CloudWatch Logs Insights query in a monitoring account can query multiple log groups in multiple source accounts at once.
You can choose to share the metrics from all namespaces with the monitoring account, or filter to a subset of namespaces.

questions.stem: A company runs workloads in four AWS accounts and in two Regions, us-east-1 and ap-northeast-1. Managers want one CloudWatch dashboard that shows graphs, alarms, and CloudWatch Logs Insights results from all accounts and both Regions together. The company wants to use built-in CloudWatch features and avoid copying data. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

choices.text: Set up CloudWatch cross-account observability in us-east-1 only, and build the dashboard in the monitoring account.
Enable the accounts as sharing accounts and the managers' account as a monitoring account, and build a cross-account cross-Region dashboard.
Build one dashboard in each Region of each account, and give managers links to all eight dashboards.
Export the metrics and logs from every account and Region to Amazon S3 each hour, and visualize them in a separate tool.

explanation.summary: cross-account cross-Region のダッシュボードは、複数のアカウントと複数のリージョンの CloudWatch のデータを 1 つのダッシュボードにまとめ、グラフ・アラーム・Logs Insights のウィジェットを置ける。作る前に、共有するアカウントと監視するアカウントを少なくとも 1 つずつ有効にする。cross-account observability は 1 つのリージョンの中のアカウントをまたぐ物。

per_choice.A: cross-account observability は 1 つのリージョンの中でアカウントをまたぐ物で、us-east-1 だけでは ap-northeast-1 のデータが入らない。
per_choice.B: 正しい。複数のアカウントとリージョンを 1 つのダッシュボードにまとめられる。
per_choice.C: 1 つのダッシュボードにする要件に合わない。
per_choice.D: データを写すことになり、要件に反する。

references.quote: You can create cross-account cross-Region dashboards, which summarize your CloudWatch data from multiple AWS accounts and multiple Regions into one dashboard.
Before you can create a cross-account cross-Region dashboard, you must enable at least one sharing account and at least one monitoring account.
With Amazon CloudWatch cross-account observability, you can monitor and troubleshoot applications that span multiple accounts within a Region.

questions.stem: A DevOps engineer manages CloudWatch dashboards as code through the CloudWatch API. A new log widget must show the results of a CloudWatch Logs Insights query over two log groups, app-a and app-b, that are in a different AWS account. The engineer wants the dashboard definition to be the only change. Which configuration choices are correct for the widget? (Choose TWO.)

choices.text: Set the accountId property of the widget to the ID of the account that contains the log groups.
Start the query string with SOURCE 'app-a' | SOURCE 'app-b' and then add a pipe character followed by the query syntax.
List the log groups separated by commas at the start of the query string, and then add the query syntax.
Create the widget in the console only, because cross-account dashboards cannot be created with the API.
Omit the view property to show the results as a line chart, which is the default view for log widgets.

explanation.summary: log の種類のウィジェットは Logs Insights の問い合わせの結果を表す。別アカウントの問い合わせでは、ログを持つアカウントの ID を指定する。問い合わせの文字列は、各ロググループの名前の前に SOURCE を付けてパイプ（|）でつなぎ、さらにパイプを置いてから問い合わせの構文を書く。

per_choice.A: 正しい。別アカウントの問い合わせでは、ログを持つアカウントの ID を指定する。
per_choice.B: 正しい。各ロググループに SOURCE を付け、パイプで区切り、パイプの後に問い合わせを書く。
per_choice.C: ロググループはパイプで区切る。
per_choice.D: API と SDK でもダッシュボードを作れ、cross-account cross-Region のための項目もある。
per_choice.E: view を省くと表で表示される。

references.quote: The account ID of the AWS account containing the logs, if this is a cross-account query.
You must pre-pend each log group name with SOURCE.
Separate multiple log groups with a pipe character (|).
If you omit this parameter, the results are displayed as a table.
To enable cross-account cross-Region dashboards, we have added new parameters to the dashboard body structure
